Name: Krobus Sells Hardwood
Author: shayvidas2022
Description:
Krobus Sells Hardwood is just that, it lets Krobus  sell hard wood once a week, this keeps game balanced and not over powering it with very easy / cheated ways to get hardwood

i feel like it's a good mod as it keeps the balanced

you dont open the sewers until later on in the game so you have to go to the secret forest anyway,

and even when you do get to the sewers Krobus will have 50 of them at a price of 200 for each.
which is 10K for al 200 

i feel this keeps game balanced and is a nice touch that makes life a lot easier but not in a cheating way.

this is only in beta for now
later on i will add ability to modify values of how much wood and how much price in game mod menu

and also add the option that hard wood will show up in the traveling cart.

so expect version 0.7 soon.

dont by shy to say thank you. in the posts that keeps me going to keep writing this mods to know people use them and like them
